name: Nolan Kido
tagline: Useful things. Clear ideas. A life beyond work.
intro: I build useful things and write about what I learn.
bio_short: Nolan Kido is an independent builder and writer interested in technology, decision-making, and creative work. His website brings together worked explanations, practical resources, and reflections on learning and making things.
bio_long: Nolan Kido is an independent builder and writer whose interests connect technology, decision-making, and creative work. He explores how an idea becomes useful, what gives a result credibility, and how to make a complicated subject easier to understand. His website is a small collection of worked explanations, editable resources, and reflections on learning, communication, and finishing things. It also leaves room for curiosity that does not need to become a project.
